Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with mechanism of action classified as PARTIAL AGONIST. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name. Do not deduplicate.
